hero.title: Terms & Conditions
hero.subtitle: The rules and guidelines that govern your use of Mobi Prop’s platform

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.intro: By accessing the Mobi Prop website, submitting property information, contacting our agents, or using any tools (such as home valuations or neighborhood guides), you confirm that:
items: You are at least 18 years old.
You agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions.
You are using the website for lawful purposes only.
sections.outro: If you do not meet these conditions, you may not use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Services we provide
sections.intro: Mobi Prop offers property-related resources including:
items: Residential and commercial property listings
Home valuation tools
Neighborhood information
Agent profiles and contact services
Property submission features
Guides, news, and blog content
sections.outro: We may update, change, or discontinue parts of the platform at any time without prior notice.

sections.heading: 3. User responsibilities
sections.intro: When using our website, you agree that:
items: All information you submit is accurate and truthful.
You will not upload false, misleading, or fraudulent property details.
You will not attempt to hack, disrupt, or misuse the website.
You will not impersonate an agent, homeowner, or another user.
sections.outro: Any misuse may result in restricted access or removal of submitted content.

sections.heading: 4. Property listings and accuracy
sections.intro: Mobi Prop strives to provide the most accurate and up-to-date information, but:
items: Property details may change without notice
Prices, availability, and features are not guaranteed
Images may be representative and not always exact
sections.outro: We encourage users to verify information independently before making decisions.

sections.heading: 5. Agent contact and communication
sections.intro: By contacting an agent through the website, you agree that:
items: Mobi Prop may forward your details to the appropriate agent.
Agents may contact you via email or phone.
You are requesting property-related assistance voluntarily.
sections.outro: We do not guarantee specific response times or outcomes.

sections.heading: 6. Third-party links and resources
sections.intro: Mobi Prop may link to outside resources or listing platforms. These external sites:
items: Are not controlled by Mobi Prop
Have their own privacy and legal policies
Are used at your own discretion
sections.outro: We are not responsible for any issues arising from third-party websites.
